definitions.explanation: A pattern of regularly spaced round dots, commonly used for fabric and design. The most frequent usage in modern Japanese.
A small, round drop of water, resembling a bead or ball.

examples.japanese: {水玉|みずたま}⟦{模様|もよう}→模様：03635_moyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スカート→スカート：01060_sukaato⟧。
⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{水玉|みずたま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ワンピース→ワンピース：04526_wanpiisu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a red and white polka dot dress.

Water droplets were glistening on the leaves.

examples.english: Round morning dew droplets are shining on the petals.

notes:
USAGE:
In modern Japanese, {水玉|みずたま} most commonly refers to polka dot patterns. The full form {水玉|みずたま}⟦{模様|もよう}→模様：03635_moyou⟧ (polka dot pattern) is often shortened to just {水玉|みずたま} when the context is clear. The literal meaning of water droplets is less common but still used poetically.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水玉|みずたま}⟦{模様|もよう}→模様：03635_moyou⟧ (polka dot pattern)
- {水玉|みずたま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧ (polka dot clothes)
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{水玉|みずたま} (large polka dots)
- ⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧{水玉|みずたま} (small polka dots)
